summary: Phase MKT.4 tested end-to-end. BACKEND: 75/75 PASS = 5 new MKT.4 (unread_count shape+auth, games/discover shape, marketplace campaigns list carries analytics fields per type — impressions/clicks (featured), plays/wins (spin/scratch), answers_count/correct_count (trivia), claims (coupon_bid), entries_count (giveaway) — plus mark-read shrinks unread_count) + iter49 19/19 + iter48 26/26 + iter47 25/25. MOBILE (Expo web preview, viewport 390×844, demo bearer): (1) Home bell home-notif-btn present; home-notif-badge shows '1' initially from GET /api/me/notifications/unread_count; tapping bell opens notif-inbox with 5 giveaway_winner items (1 unread dot); tapping the unread item marks it read; returning to Home shows home-notif-badge count=0 (badge hidden) — full loop verified. (2) /merchant/marketplace shows 35 mkt-stats-{campaign_id} rows with correct labels per campaign type: trivia → ANSWERS/CORRECT, coupon_bid → CLAIMS, giveaway → ENTRIES, spin/scratch → PLAYS/WINS, plus a SPEND pill on every row (values match campaign.spent_usd). Existing create wizard (mkt-start → mkt-goal-* → mkt-type-* → mkt-launch) and pause/activate/draw testIDs still present. WEB (?design=radiolife): rl-overlay confirmed present on /wallet and /discover; rl-return-to-legacy pill present on discover and functional (clicking it removes the overlay → returns to legacy). However, in this test run the inner testIDs rl-gaming-page/rl-rewards-page/rl-discover-page did NOT render — the browser timing appears to have caught /wallet+/discover on OnboardingRadioLife (auth cookie mid-flight) and /play fell through to legacy (rl-overlay=0). A purple-ish computed style was detected on /play, sourced from the LEGACY gaming page (class `text-purple-*`), NOT from GamingRadioLife.jsx (which uses text-orange-600). Recommend main agent self-verify the 3 RL pages after ~7-8s auth settle window — GamingRadioLife.jsx, RewardsWalletRadioLife.jsx, DiscoverRadioLife.jsx source files all carry the correct testids and cream/orange tokens; no code bug spotted in the RadioLifeOverlay routing.

integration_issues.issue: In this run the inner RL page testids (rl-gaming-page, rl-rewards-page, rl-discover-page) were not found. rl-overlay=1 on /wallet+/discover (overlay is mounted) and rl-return-to-legacy is present + functional, but the inner pages likely rendered OnboardingRadioLife because auth cookie was mid-flight. On /play, rl-overlay=0 and legacy page rendered — purple text detected is from legacy /play, not RL screen. Test timing artifact, not necessarily a code bug — main agent self-verify with a longer login wait recommended.

critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/design_radiolife/screens/GamingRadioLife.jsx: uses window.axios via `${API}/games/discover` but does not send Authorization header — currently OK for cookie-auth web, but if the RL variant ever runs bare/mobile-like this will 401. Consider adding withCredentials (already there) + a fallback bearer via AuthContext to keep it robust.

frontend/src/design_radiolife/RadioLifeOverlay.jsx: `if (!isBare && !user) return null` silently swallows unauthenticated /play|/wallet|/discover — user sees the LEGACY page underneath which likely has purple text (as observed). Consider forwarding to /login?design=radiolife instead of falling through, so the ?design=radiolife intent is preserved after sign-in.

mobile/app/(tabs)/home.tsx.load: unread_count try/catch is silent — no retry-on-fail. If the endpoint 500s during a session, the bell will silently show no badge until next full-load. Not critical but flag it.

mobile/app/merchant/marketplace.tsx.campStats: type 'featured' shows Views/Taps but there's no CTR percentage — merchants would benefit from a quick 'x% CTR' derived stat next to Spend. Suggestion, not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: Mobile MKT.4: 100% of spec testIDs verified (home-notif-badge shows count, hides after read; mkt-stats-* per type verified). Web MKT.4: partial — overlay + toggle verified; inner RL page testids need main-agent self-verify due to test-run auth-timing race.

Mobile home-notif-badge only renders when unread_count>0 — clear it by tapping unread items in /notifications inbox.
rca of the issue: No code bug identified. The web RL variant inner-page testids were not observed in this run because (a) demo-login-btn click was followed by only ~3.5s wait — likely insufficient for cookie+/api/auth/demo round-trip to populate AuthContext.user before the /play navigation, causing the overlay's `if (!user) return null` guard to fall through to legacy /play (whose lucide Trophy has a text-purple- class that surfaced in the purple-scan). Subsequent /wallet+/discover had rl-overlay=1 (overlay mounted) but inner pages likely rendered OnboardingRadioLife (via /login fallback) rather than the target RL screens. GamingRadioLife.jsx, RewardsWalletRadioLife.jsx, DiscoverRadioLife.jsx sources all carry the correct testids and cream/orange tokens per the diff. Recommend main agent re-open /login?design=radiolife → demo login → wait ~8s → then visit /play, /wallet, /discover with ?design=radiolife each to confirm.
